issueCommentThread.body:
Adoption blocker.

This is about Gates: the check that stands in the doorway before work is called good. A green result should mean Directive actually looked. A red result should say what to do next.

What a new person hits: To mark the work finished, the error tells them to type a human-origin value by hand. That is the same kind of self-certified answer the product is supposed to reject.

Why that ruins the product for them: Finishing honestly is blocked, and the suggested fix is to fake the paperwork. People who notice will not trust the finish line.

How likely: Medium. They have to get all the way to "mark this done." People who do are already invested, and this is a sour ending.

## Missing-path copy is not enough guidance
blocks-the-design
Evidence: At `650ab1a614cd6049b4c70c2b48fa181ffef5455e`, `parseDisposition` in `packages/core/src/scope/acceptance-evidence.ts` returns `disposition.provenance is required (human-origin)` when `asRecord(obj.provenance)` is null (missing or non-object). The same file's `evaluateAcceptanceEvidenceGate` field-spec and `content/commands.md` § `scope:complete` both write `provenance (human-origin)` as prose. `AcceptanceDispositionRecord.provenance` is typed as GrantOrigin `kind` + `actor` (other fields optional). `HUMAN_ORIGIN_KINDS` is the closed set `operator-cli|operator-session|human-event`; `isHumanOrigin` rejects empty actor and agent-shaped actors. Fixtures already stamp a recordable object (`humanProv` with `kind: "operator-cli"`, `actor: "operator@example.com"`). `task scope:stamp-evidence` is documented evidence-only with no disposition argv.
Failure mode: An actor at `scope:complete` who follows the missing-path refusal plus the field-spec treats parenthetical `human-origin` as the value to record. A bare string (or any non-object) re-enters the same `asRecord` null path and reprints the identical refusal, so the finish line never discloses a stampable `{ kind, actor }` object. That is the self-asserted grant shape the gate is built to reject, while shared complete authority still depends on a passing human-origin disposition.
Disposition: The presumption that current missing-path copy plus prose field-spec is enough guidance cannot bind. Before bind, the missing-path refusal and the operator-facing field-spec/help must emit a recordable GrantOrigin shape (kind from the closed human-origin set plus a non-agent actor), reusing the existing `isHumanOrigin` / `stampNamespacedDisposition` mechanisms rather than inventing a second provenance system.

## Invalid-object path already names kinds
sharpens-framing
Evidence: The present-but-invalid branch in the same `parseDisposition` returns `disposition.provenance must be human-origin (kind operator-cli|operator-session|human-event + non-agent actor)`. The agent-origin fixture (`kind: "operator-cli"`, `actor: "agent:worker"`) fails closed on that gate. The Stop 1 pains read as if every refusal and help surface is silent on GrantOrigin shape.
Failure mode: Binding a remedy that rewrites every provenance refusal, or that opens a new mint/CLI surface for disposition, overscopes past the measured hole: the missing-path message and the `provenance (human-origin)` prose in the gate summary and `commands.md`.
Disposition: Narrow the bind to the missing-path refusal plus the field-spec/help prose that still say `(human-origin)`. Keep the invalid-object message's kind list as the existing disclosure for malformed objects; extend missing-path and docs to the same recordable object shape.

## Injection / swarm lens on complete authority
footnote
Evidence: Disposition stamps ride `evaluateAcceptanceEvidenceGate` / `scope:complete` and already call `isHumanOrigin` on a reconstructed `GrantOrigin`. `REJECTED_ORIGIN_KINDS` includes `self-asserted`; literal kind `human-origin` is simply outside `HUMAN_ORIGIN_KINDS`.
Failure mode: A copy-only fix that began accepting a bare string as provenance would widen shared complete authority without a human GrantOrigin.
Disposition: No separate product surface required beyond keeping the existing structural gate while fixing the guidance that currently withholds the recordable value.

## Verdict
The refutation target does not survive. Printing `disposition.provenance is required (human-origin)` plus the prose field-spec is not enough guidance: those surfaces invite a non-recordable shape, and the missing-path path never offers a GrantOrigin `{ kind, actor }` value the receiving actor can stamp.

## In plain English

When disposition.provenance is missing, scope:complete prints "required (human-origin)" and a prose field-spec that invite a bare string. That string is not a recordable GrantOrigin, so the finish line loops on the same refusal. The invalid-object path already names the closed kind list; the hole is the missing-path copy and the field-spec/help prose. Confirming this map means the Bound remedy list is the build contract. The same parent wrote the Stop 1 warrant and this map. Critic 5857538414 checks the findings. Whether the list covers the three pains stays open until a later critic targets those cites.

**Lean:** the refutation target does not survive. This map is the bind.

metadata.issueBody:
Parent: #4842

## Finding

The refusal says disposition.provenance is required (human-origin) and prints a field spec whose provenance slot reads as prose. That is the self-asserted grant human-origin authz rejects, and neither the refusal nor the command help offers a value the receiving actor can actually record.

Split out of #4842 so the parent stays a tracker and this failure can be triaged on its own. A fix for the other findings on that report would not close this one.

## Normalization

- Promise: GATES
- Priority: High (audit scale S2)
- Source: #4842
